title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Enrollment and Assignment of the Certification Plan
content:
**Clause 1 — One profile per loan, one open profile per borrower.** Each funded reverse mortgage is enrolled in exactly one Occupancy and Residency Certification profile, and because a borrower can hold only one reverse mortgage on a principal residence, a borrower holds at most 1 open profile. A profile is enrolled only when the borrower has no other profile whose status is pending first certification, current, overdue, absence monitoring or non-occupancy confirmed. The test is made on the company's profile records for that borrower, before enrollment.

**Clause 2 — Choice of plan.** The plan is chosen from the household on the loan record. When more than one plan's entry conditions hold, the first match in this order applies:

1. Deferral Period Certification
2. Authorized Representative Certification
3. Living Trust Certification
4. Non-Borrowing Spouse Household Certification
5. Joint Borrower Certification
6. Standard Annual Certification

**Clause 3 — First due date.** The first certification due date is the first anniversary of the loan's closing date. A newly enrolled profile starts as pending its first certification, enrolled on the funding date.

## Entry conditions of each plan

| Plan | Entry conditions on the loan record |
|---|---|
| Standard Annual Certification | exactly one living borrower; no non-borrowing spouse on the loan; title not held in trust; the borrower does not sign through a representative |
| Joint Borrower Certification | at least two living borrowers; title not held in trust; no signing through a representative |
| Non-Borrowing Spouse Household Certification | at least one living borrower; an eligible non-borrowing spouse on the loan |
| Deferral Period Certification | no living borrower; the loan is in its deferral period |
| Living Trust Certification | title held in trust; a certification of trust on file |
| Authorized Representative Certification | the borrower signs through a representative; a power of attorney or guardianship order on file |

## Points of judgement

- *Open profiles counted.* Only the five listed statuses count as an open profile. A profile whose status is closed is not among them and therefore does not by itself bar a new enrollment.
- *Overlapping households.* The order in Clause 2 settles every overlap. Hypothetical household A — two living borrowers with title held in a living trust and a certification of trust on file — meets the entry conditions of Living Trust Certification (third in order) and not those of Joint Borrower Certification, which requires title not held in trust; it is enrolled under Living Trust Certification. Hypothetical household B — one living borrower who signs through an attorney-in-fact with a power of attorney on file, and an eligible non-borrowing spouse on the loan — meets the entry conditions of Authorized Representative Certification and of Non-Borrowing Spouse Household Certification; the second in order, Authorized Representative Certification, applies.
- *First due date.* For a hypothetical loan closed on 10 August of one year, the first due date is 10 August of the following year.
